stem: Widely regarded as the 'Father of the Indian Space Programme', this scientist founded the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and the Physical Research Laboratory, and was instrumental in establishing India's first rocket launching station at Thumba. He was:
explanation: Vikram Sarabhai is regarded as the 'Father of the Indian Space Programme' and founded ISRO — distinct from Homi Bhabha (father of India's nuclear programme, founded TIFR and BARC) and APJ Abdul Kalam (missile scientist and later President of India).

subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Widely regarded as the 'Father of the Indian Nuclear Programme', this physicist founded the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) and the Atomic Energy Establishment (later renamed BARC in his honour after his death. He was:
explanation: Homi J. Bhabha founded TIFR and laid the foundation of India's atomic energy programme — the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) in Mumbai is named after him, distinct from Vikram Sarabhai's contributions to the space programme.
